offers_products.reason: Main offering is housing and care in senior living communities; no goods sold as a main offering.

offers_services.reason: Assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, independent living and Brookdale at Home care services for residents.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Seniors and their families choose and live in communities, paying monthly bills as residents.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Residents and families are the buyers; payers like Medicare do not choose the purchase.

recurring_revenue.reason: Residents pay monthly rent and care fees, billed on the first of each month.

cyclical_demand.reason: Senior care and housing for memory care and assisted living are needs-based and hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay monthly fees rather than a single large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value combines care staff with residential buildings and housing; the communities are central, not just staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual seniors and their families.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates over 500 senior living communities in 41 states, requiring owned or leased real estate and upkeep.
